profile.headline: Sr. Oracle EPM Professional | Welch Scholar | MBA | MSEE
profile.summary:
Seasoned Oracle EPM Senior Engineer with 15+ years of expertise architecting, implementing, and supporting enterprise-wide financial performance management solutions using Oracle Hyperion EPM Suite. Extensive hands-on experience with EPBCS, FCCS, Freeform, Essbase (ASO/BSO), SmartView, and Excel Add-ins, enabling end-to-end support for planning, forecasting, budgeting, and financial close cycles. Skilled in both on-premises and cloud EPM environments, with deep understanding of multidimensional modeling, metadata design, and cube optimization.

Expert in installing, configuring, upgrading, and tuning EPM components across standalone and HA/clustered environments. Proficient in building and managing calculation scripts, rules files, load rules, data maps, transparent partitions, and metadata integration across multiple applications. Adept at automating data loads, metadata sync, backup/recovery, and report generation workflows using MaxL scripting, EPMAutomate, and shell/batch scripting.

Proven ability to support business-critical applications by resolving complex technical issues, reducing system latency, and ensuring data accuracy across diverse source systems including Oracle DB, SQL Server, Oracle GL, Google Cloud Storage, and flat files. Experienced in building and distributing dynamic reporting solutions using SmartView, VBA, and Essbase Add-ins, with strong focus on usability, performance, and auditability.

A trusted partner to finance and IT teams, with strong communication and documentation skills, a commitment to operational excellence, and a track record of driving process improvements, minimizing downtime, and delivering stable, scalable EPM solutions.
